title: Cheese Ravioli with Green Olive, Almond and Orange Pesto
changes_from_base: Green olives, toasted almonds, parsley, orange zest and juice and parmesan are blended into a pesto that replaces the butter sauce, with shop-bought cheese ravioli in place of homemade.
summary: Cheese ravioli in a lively pesto of green olives, toasted almonds and bright orange zest.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt, for the cooking water

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Fill a large pot with around 4000 ml water and bring to the boil.

steps.title: Blanch
steps.text: Boil 2 unpeeled garlic cloves for 1 min, chill under cold water before peeling and chopping.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook 680 g cheese ravioli with 1 tbsp salt to al dente, stirring now and then; keep back 120 ml of the water before draining and returning them to the pot.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Pulse the garlic, 70 g green olives, 30 g parsley, 40 g parmesan, 55 g flaked almonds, ½ tsp orange zest and 2 tbsp orange juice for 20-30 pulses until finely ground, scraping down.

steps.title: Stream
steps.text: With the blade turning, drizzle in 120 ml olive oil slowly until it is fully combined.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir through ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper, tasting first as the olives are salty.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Mix the ravioli carefully with about 240 ml of the olive, almond and orange pesto, loosening with cooking water a spoonful at a time, and serve any extra on the side.

tips: Taste before you season, as the olives bring plenty of salt already.
The ravioli label will flag any egg.
safety: Almonds feature in this pesto, so alert anyone with a nut allergy.
storage: Keep leftover pesto chilled under a film of oil for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
